_help: key: the key to hold for the wheel (Unreal's name: G, B, Tab...; not T, which opens the game's map). pad: the controller button (Gamepad_DPad_Down, Gamepad_DPad_Up...). poses: the game's 14 photo-mode poses on the wheel. pause: the world holds still while the wheel is open. mouse: how far the mouse moves the pointer (1 as made).
